people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
translations.bsb: How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in pure gold, are now esteemed as jars of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
